cves.title: Cisco ubr900 series routers that conform to the Data-over-Cable Service Interface Specifications (DOCSIS) sta…
cves.description: Cisco ubr900 series routers that conform to the Data-over-Cable Service Interface Specifications (DOCSIS) standard must ship without SNMP access restrictions, which can allow remote attackers to read and write information to the MIB using arbitrary community strings.

cves.title: SNMP service in Atmel 802.11b VNET-B Access Point 1.3 and earlier, as used in Netgear ME102 and Linksys WAP11…
cves.description: SNMP service in Atmel 802.11b VNET-B Access Point 1.3 and earlier, as used in Netgear ME102 and Linksys WAP11, accepts arbitrary community strings with requested MIB modifications, which allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information such as WEP keys, cause a denial of service, or gain access to the network.

cves.title: Crosscom/Olicom XLT-F running XL 80 IM Version 5.5 Build Level 2 allows a remote attacker SNMP read and write…
cves.description: Crosscom/Olicom XLT-F running XL 80 IM Version 5.5 Build Level 2 allows a remote attacker SNMP read and write access via a default, undocumented community string 'ILMI'.
